question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is focused **on the health benefits of consuming fruits and vegetables, including their nutritional value.**
 
• Fruits and vegetables are known **for their nutrient content, which is essential for good health.**
 
• "**Nutrients**" fits well as it refers to the vitamins, minerals, and other beneficial compounds found in fruits and vegetables that contribute to health.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is **'nutrients.'**

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read **"When buying and serving fruit and vegetables, aim for variety to get the most nutrients__ and appeal."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("assortment", "fun", "advancement") do not accurately convey the idea of beneficial dietary components.

 
• **Assortment** (विविधता): "Assortment" means a collection of different types of items, which does not fit the context of describing the benefits of nutrients.
 
• **Fun** (मजा): "Fun" refers to enjoyment or amusement, which is irrelevant in the context of nutritional health benefits.
 
• **Advancement** (प्रगति): "Advancement" refers to progress or development, which does not align with the idea of dietary components.
